newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD V AJAX FACTS AND FIGURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD V AJAX FACTS AND FIGURES.

text.p: Facts and figures for Sunday's Dutch first division league match between Feyenoord and Ajax Amsterdam.
Major honours: European Champions 1970; UEFA Cup winners
1974; World Super Cup winners 1970; Dutch league champions (13)
Record League Goalscorer: Cor van der Gijp, 162.
Most capped player: Ronald Koeman, Netherlands, 78, 1983-95
European Cup Winners Cup winners 1987; UEFA Cup winners 1992;
World Club Cup winners 1972, 1995; Dutch league champions (26)
Most capped player: Ruud Krol, Netherlands, 83, 1969-83.
Feyenoord v Ajax Amsterdam league record:
Played 40 (since start of Dutch professional soccer in 1956)
Last 10 seasons in Rotterdam from 1986-87 (Feyenoord score
Corresponding match last season: Oct 22, 1995, Feyenoord 2

Fascinating facts: Anyone betting on a 0-0 scoreline should note that there has never been a goalless draw between these two sides in Rotterdam. They have, however, shared nine 1-1 draws. Arnold Scholten and Ronald Koeman are among few players who have played for both Ajax and Feyenoord.
